research_question: Q4 / core: adoption, not one-off plays
top_keywords: music; new; artist; new music; love; like
example_quote: World Music. I love exploring music from around the world. I have been able to find a very nice variety to soothe my soul.

topic: No guided on-ramp into a new genre

top_keywords: playlist; genre; week; ramp; guided; guided ramp

topic: Stuck in a listening loop / same songs on repeat

research_question: Q4 repeat-listening of the same content
